integrity: An explicit all-parameter proof supplies the full representation decomposition; finite exact-modular tests corroborate, but do not replace, the proof. Originality is assessed against inspected sources rather than independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Complex coefficients; exactly three nonempty consecutive layers with every adjacent-level arc and no nonconsecutive shortcuts; unreduced nonregular Mayer path homology. No assertion for sparse interlayer graphs, augmented variants, or extra layers.
title: Exact Mayer path homology and symmetry of shortcut-free three-level networks
